Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stroll out to the middle. Imam-ul-Haq and Fakhar Zaman are the openers for Pakistan. Jason Behrendorff to start with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! 211 for Pakistan to chase and should not be a difficult one considering they chased down 349 on the same track in the second ODI. Their batters are in good form and Pakistan would be banking on them to perform and win the series. Australia need their bowlers to step up and they would want early wickets here. If they manage to get that, we are in for a thriller. Stay tuned to find out how things pan out.

Haris Rauf is up for a chat. He says that Finch's pads are to be targeted early on and they got success doing just that. Adds that how the wickets are here, one has to bowl stump to stump and one needs to be accurate because Australia have good batters. Mentions that how they won the second match gave the team a morale booster and we just want to give 100 percent and the results will come. Also adds that the coaching staff is very helpful and they always back them to do well. Ends by saying the form in which Imam and Zaman are in, hopefully, it's a simple chase.

Pakistan bowlers were just breathing fire. Shaheen Afridi set the tone by getting a wicket off the first ball and then Haris Rauf bagged two in quick succession to blow Australia away. The bowlers continued to bowl with discipline and kept things very tight. They had to work a little hard to break Carey'-Green's resilience and were frustrated by Abbott's knock but still their pacers have performed well as a unit and would fancy this chase. Each and every bowlers got a wicket at least and bowled in unison. Mohammad Wasim and Haris Rauf were the stars for Pakistan picking up 3 wickets apieice.

Australia were left in complete disarray as they lost Travis Head and Aaron Finch for ducks and then Marnus Labuschagne also fell cheaply. They were reeling at 6/3 and needed a long partnership to get out of the rut. Ben McDermott and Marcus Stoinis did build a partnership but didn't last long enough as the latter fell. Cameron Green and Alex Carey's partnership seemed to be threatening but once that was broken, everything was left on the tailenders to make an impact which was always going to be a tough ask. However, Sean Abbott played a blinder adding some valuable runs and helped his team get past 200 and made sure their bowlers have a chance to make something out of this match.

300+ scores batting first in both the ODIs and you'd think Australia would once again rack up runs this time considering it's the same pitch they are playing on but this time it wasn't to be. Except for Carey and a counter-punch from Abbott, no one made an impact and kept losing wickets. A decent performance from them and they have been bundled for 210. Pakistan bowlers were right on the money from the start. They had to toil hard for the last wicket but nevertheless, it was a wonderful display of fast bowling from the hosts and would take this score on any given day.

OUT! CAUGHT! Boy, Pakistan were made work hard for this last wicket but finally they get it. Credit to Sean Abbott though for playing an exceptional knock. He has added some valuable runs for his side here. Short ball from Rauf, on middle. Sean Abbott looks to ramp it over short third man but miscues it straight to Mohammad Wasim there. Australia have been bundled out for 210.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Wasim b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, on off. Driven towards covers.
Two again! Short and on off, Sean Abbott pulls it hard and to deep square leg. The fielder there runs to his left and stops the ball from racing away. Good fielding and keeps it down to two.
Sean Abbott is playing a terrific knock here! Short of a length, outside off. Sean Abbott tries to pull but gets his gloves on it and the balls to third man for a brace.
On a length, outside off. Sean Abbott slaps it to long on and denies the single.
Tossed up on middle. Adam Zampa defends it out.
Smart batting from Abbott as he gets the single with just one ball to go. Around off, Abbott rocks back and plays it through point for a single.
Tossed up, on off and this is pushed towards cover.
FOUR! Sean Abbott takes full advantage of the life he got on the previous ball. Dragged down, around off, this is slapped through covers for a boundary.

A comedy of errors as three fielders are stood still looking at each other. Short and around off. Abbott looks to power it down the ground but gets a top edge towards point. The keeper, the point fielder and one more fielder run towards it but no one calls for it or goes for it. Abbott survives.
Slowed up, on a length and around off. Sean Abbott hangs back and looks for the big hit downtown but gets beaten by the turn.
On middle at 144.7 kph. Zampa keeps it out.

Valiant effort but it is dropped! Haris Rauf bowls a well-directed bouncer around off and gets it high enough. Sean Abbott looks to take it on but has no control of the hook shot as he ends up getting a top edge towards the mid-wicket region. Shaheen Afridi runs behind and slides it but just can't hold on. Single taken.
Length, on off and pulled towards the man at mid-wicket.
Banged in short, on middle. Abbott pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and denies the single.
FOUR! Full and wide at 145.7 kph. Sean Abbott just opens the face of the blade and creams it through point for a boundary. What a knock this has been so far! 200 is up for the visitors.
Fullish delivery, around off. This is mistimed towards wide mid on.
Length ball, around leg. This is worked through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Make that 20 off the over and there's still a ball left! Afridi comes over the wicket and bangs it in short. Sean Abbott is ready for it and comes down the track to pull it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! 16 off the first four deliveries and Sean Abbott is giving Shaheen Afridi a headache. Full and straight, jammed out through the extra cover region for a boundary.
SIX! Sean Abbott giving Australia a fighting chance here. Right in the slot on off stump. Abbott clears his front leg and shanks it right back over the bowler's head for a huge hit.
Slower one, around off. Abbott looks to lift it over mid off and just about manages to do so. Two taken.

FOUR! These are valuable runs for Australia. Sean Abbott shuffles across the stumps and Afridi tries to follow him with a yorker. Afridi misses and serves a full toss, Abbott manages to paddle it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Full and straight, Adam Zampa thumps it towards covers. End of a brilliant spell from Mohammad Wasim as he finishes with 3 wickets for 40 runs.
On off, Zampa solidly blocks it out.
Angling on the pads, Zampa looks to tuck it away but misses. He gets hit on the pads.
Full and straight, drilled down to long on for one.
Banged in short, outside off. Sean Abbott comes down the track and lifts it over covers. Three men from the inner ring chase it down and keep it down to two.
Slight misfield and the batters get two with ease. On the pads, flicked away towards deep backward square leg for a couple.
Back of a length, on off. Zampa dabs it down on the off side.
Full and straight, blocked out by Zampa.
Leg bye! Slower this time, angled into the pads. Abbott looks to swing across the line but gets hit on the pads. They scamper through for a leg bye.
Afridi nails the reverse-swinging yorker on leg stump. Sean Abbott does well to get a bat on it.
Full and a bit wide, driven through covers for a brace.
In the air but short of the fielder. Full, on off. Sean Abbott looks to cover drive but hits it uppishly to the fielder over there.
Around the top of off, nudged away towards point.
WIDE! Full and well down the leg side, good work from Rizwan to get to it. Wide signalled.

OUT! TIMBER! Too hot to handle for Nathan Ellis and Mohammad Wasim has his third! Just short of a length again from Wasim, on off and this one tails back in late. Nathan Ellis makes a bit of room to play it on the off side but the ball just zips through and goes through the defense to hit the top of off. The bails go flying and Australia have just one wicket remaining. Adam Zampa is the last man in for the visitors.
Full and outside off, tailing back in late. Nathan Ellis crunches it through covers and picks up a couple of runs.
WIDE! This is spilled down the leg side. Wide called.
Length again, around the top of off. Ellis gets a bottom edge back onto the deck.
Good-length, on off. Ellis dabs it down on the off side.

Risky single but Sean Abbott survives! Back of a length, on off. Abbott comes down the track and gives it a hoick but mistimes it completely towards mid-wicket. Abbott sets off for a quick run and the fielder misses the shy at the bowler's end.
Nathan Ellis walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shaheen Afridi gets back into the attack and bags a wicket. He does the job again for his captain. Fuller in length, on middle. Jason Behrendorff looks to flick but finds short mid-wicket to perfection. Fakhar Zaman there doesn't have to move an inch and he grabs the dolly with both hands.
Commentary.Howout: c Fakhar Zaman b Shaheen Afridi

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, on off. Driven to mid on for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! Good-length ball, outside off. Sean Abbott leans and drives it in between extra cover and mid off. The ball races away to the fence.
Length, on middle. Sean Abbott pushes it to mid on.
Length ball, on off. Jason Behrendorff pushes it uppishly through covers for a single.
Full and outside off, Jason Behrendorff digs it out.
Shaheen Afridi (5-2-11-1) is back on.
On a length, outside off. Sean Abbott swings but misses.

Good-length ball, on middle and leg, Jason Behrendorff hops and looks to defend but misses. He gets hit on the pads and Mohammad Wasim puts up an appeal but Aleem Dar says no. The ball rolls to the off side and the batters take a single meanwhile. Babar Azam signals T sign and goes for the review. UltraEdge shows that there was an inside edge there.
Full and on middle, Jason Behrendorff jams it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Defended towards covers.
On a length, outside off. Pushed to mid off.
Length ball, tailing back in, on middle. Jason Behrendorff looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Jason Behrendorff comes in at number 9 for Australia.

OUT! CAUGHT! Alex Carey's fine innings comes to and end as well. A huge wicket for Pakistan. Tossed up, on middle and leg, Alex Carey decides to take the aerial route now. He comes down the track and heaves it towards cow corner. Fakhar Zaman there cover good ground running from long on and takes the catch with both hands right on the edge of the fence. A good sharp catch from him and Alex Carey will have to walk back. He will be gutted but has played a good knock for his side.
Commentary.Howout: c Fakhar Zaman b Iftikhar Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This time Carey makes the connection! Floats it up, outside off. Alex Carey prods and smashes it over covers for a boundary.
This is pushed to long on for a single. Sean Abbott is off the mark.
Full and outside off, Sean Abbott tries to sweep but gets hit on the pads.
Short and outside off, Alex Carey dances down the pitch and looks to go over covers. The ball goes off the outside edge and falls just short of the short third man. The batters take a single.
Short and on off, Alex Carey looks to cut but gets it off the inside half back to the bowler.
Touch fuller, outside off. Sean Abbott drives it to mid off. Excellent over from Mohammad Wasim. A wicket and just one run off it.
WIDE! Length ball down the leg side, Sean Abbott misses his flick. Mohammad Rizwan does well to collect it diving to his left. Wided.
Full and on middle, pushed to mid on.
Length ball, outside off, nipping in. Sean Abbott looks to drive but gets beaten.
Length ball, on off, tailing back in. Sean Abbott blocks it from the crease.
Back of a length, on off. Sean Abbott hops and blocks.
Sean Abbott is the next man in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Look at Mohammad Wasim go! He provides the breakthrough and is pumped up. Short of a length, on leg. Cameron Green tries to take him on and brings out the pull shot but misses it completely. The ball goes past his blade and shatters the stumps. The 81-run stand is broken and Pakistan are into the tail-enders now.

Tossed up, on leg, angling in with the arm. Alex Carey looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad. Iftikhar Ahmed appeals for an lbw but the umpire says no. Top over from Iftikhar Ahmed. Just 2 runs off it.
Loopy ball, on leg, Cameron Green uses his feet and pushes it to long on for one.
Sliding down leg, Cameron Green pulls it to square leg. Iftikhar Ahmed gets away with that one.
Loopy ball, on middle. Knocked back to the bowler.
Floats it up, on off. Cameron Green prods and pushes it to point.
Outside off, Alex Carey chops it to deep backward point for a single.

Just tailing back a bit and that could have been curtains for Cameron Green. Length ball, close to the off stump. Green goes for the big hoick leg side but gets beaten past the inside edge and the ball misses the off stump by a whisker.
Pitched up, around off. Green crunches the cover-drive but straight to the fielder.
Right in the blockhole from Wasim this time. Green digs it out towards mid on.

Fifty for Alex Carey and what a counter-attacking knock this has been! Good-length, on off. Carey just dabs it down towards point and sets off for a quick single. He will now be eyeing the three-figure mark from here.
Wasim goes fuller and angles it across off. Carey drives it towards extra cover.
SIX! My word, that is a fine shot! A length ball, on off. Alex Carey keeps his head still and just lifts it over the long off fence for a maximum.
Quicker one, around off. This is cut away towards deep cover for one more. 13 off the over.
Around off and this is drilled down to long on by Green for another single.
On off, pushed down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Cheeky but effective! Fuller and on middle and leg. Alex Carey gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it fine. The ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Runs are flowing now for Australia. Flatter again, on middle. Carey heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Fired into off stump by Iftikhar Ahmed. Carey just hits through the line and powers it through extra cover for a boundary.
SIX! Dragged down and punished! Zahid Mahmood serves a half-tracker on off. Cameron Green rocks back and flat-bats it all the way over the cow corner fence for a biggie.
On the pads, swept away behind square for a run by Carey.
Quicker and flatter, on off. Green cuts it towards covers for one more.
On the pads, this is worked off the back foot behind square on the leg side for a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side again, this time Carey leaves it.
Poor delivery and Alex Carey certainly missed out there. Spilled way down the leg side, Carey sweeps it straight to the man at short fine leg.
Mahmood sees Carey coming down the track and drags back his length. Carey has to adjust and block it out.
Around off, driven through cover-point for just a single. These two motoring along nicely at the moment for Australia.
Around off, Carey gets down on one knee and looks to slog across the line. He gets an inside edge towards square leg.
Quicker one, speared into off stump. Green eases it down to long on for one more.
On off, Green looks to cover drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flatter again, darted into middle and leg. Cameron Green goes deep in his crease to work it leg side but gets an inside edge down towards fine leg. The batters collect a couple of runs.
Flatter delivery, around off. This is slapped through cover-point for a single.
Bit of width on offer and this is cut away behind point by Green for a couple of runs.
Short ball, outside off. Green rocks back but can't get it through the cover region.
Around leg, this is swept away towards short fine leg for a quick single.
On the pads, Carey skips down the track and looks to work it leg side but can't.
Tossed up, on off. Green pushes at it and gets a leading edge past the bowler for a single.
On a shorter length, drifted into the pads. Green blocks it off the back foot.
Short and on middle, Cameron Green pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. At the halfway mark, Australia are 107/5.
Tossed up, on off. Green defends it to the off side.
Floats it up, on off. Alex Carey cuts it to deep cover for an easy single.
Full and outside off, Cameron Green drags it to long on for another single.
Flatter, on off. Cut away to deep cover for a run.
Short and on middle, punched down to long on for a single.
Good-length ball, on middle. Cameron Green gets behind the line and defends towards covers for another quick single.
Length ball, on the pads. Alex Carey chips it to mid-wicket for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Fuller in length, on off. Cameron Green pushes it to cover for a single. 100 uo for Australia!
On the pads, pushed to mid on for a single.
Alex Carey is living dangerously! Full and outside off, off-paced. Alex Carey moves across to slash but miscues it to mid on where the ball falls just short of the fielder.
A low full toss, on off. Cameron Green pushes it to mid off for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up, on off. Alex Carey uses his feet and lifts it over covers for a glorious boundary.

Outside off, Alex Carey dabs it to backward point. He sets off for a single and is halfway down the track but Cameron Green says no and sends him back. Haris Rauf fails to collect the ball quickly and that allows Alex Carey to get back to the crease. A quick pickup and throw and Alex Carey was a goner.
Four dots in a row! Full and on middle, Alex Carey looks to sweep but slips in the process.
Floats it up, on off. Blocked out.
Tossed up, on off. Alex Carey looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pad.
Loopy ball, outside off. Alex Carey reverse-sweeps but straight to short third man.
On a length, outside off. Alex Carey cuts it to deep point for a single.
Full and outside off, Alex Carey prods and looks for the big expansive drive but the length isn't there to hit. He pushes it towards covers.
Length ball, on off. Carey dabs it to the off side.
On a good length, on off. Alex Carey defends it towards covers off the front foot.
Good-length ball, on off. Cameron Green hops and taps it to point for a quick single.
FOUR! Edgy! Excellent line and length from Haris Rauf, outside off. Cameron Green goes for the drive but the ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a boundary.
Haris Rauf (5-1-19-2) is back on.
Quicker one, on middle. Cameron Green steps out and pushes it to long on. He retains the strike with a single.
Tossed up, on off. Cameron Green hangs back and defends.
Floats it up, on off. Alex Carey drives it to long off for one.
Loopy ball, on leg. Alex Carey clips it on the leg side.
Full and on off, worked to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Cameron Green punches it to mid on.
A bit wider, Carey presses forward and pushes it towards covers.
Length again, around off. This is tapped through point for a single.
Edged but safe! A length ball, outside off. Carey looks to steer it away but gets an outside edge past first slip. The fielder over there gets a hand on it and keeps it down to a single.
'Catch' is the call but it lands well in front of Babar Azam. Full. on off and Carey just looks to wrist it onto the leg side. The ball goes uppishly towards wide mid on but falls well short.
Fuller in length, angling across the left-hander. Carey drives it to the cover region.
Excellent running! Good-length, on off. Green hangs back and dabs it down to point and scampers through for a single.
FOUR! Easily done! Tossed up, on off. Alex Carey skips down the track and lifts it almost all the way over the long off fence but the ball falls just short. It's a boundary nevertheless.
Around middle and leg, worked towards mid on.
A tad bit short and wide, cut away through cover-point for a run.
Nicely flighted, outside off. Cameron Green uses his feet looking to drive but gets it off the inner half of the bat onto the leg side.
A bit quicker, around leg stump. Alex Carey plays the reverse sweep and gets it towards deep point for a single.
Around middle, blocked.
On off, Green watchfully blocks it out. Maiden!
A bit wider this time and this is hit straight towards covers.
Around the top of off, kept out by Green.
Fullish ball, on off. Green looks to drive on the up but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Length ball, slanted into middle. Green gets right behind the line to make the block.
Sliding on the pads, Green misses the flick and gets hit on the pads.
Fuller, on off and pushed away through extra cover for one more by Green.
On the pads, worked through square leg for one.
FOUR! Calculated risk from Carey. Tossed up, around off. Carey picks up the flight early and steps out, lifting it easily over mid off for a boundary.
Loopy ball, full and down leg. Alex Carey looks to sweep but misses and the ball goes off the pads towards short fine leg. The bowler seems interested but doesn't get support from anyone else.
On middle, Carey strides out to defend.
Tossed up, around off. This is stroked away with the spin towards sweeper cover for a run.
Full and quick, around off. Green looks to cover drive but gets an inside edge past the stumps and towards short fine leg. They get a single.
Fuller this time, on middle. This is pushed towards mid-wicket.
Beaten! Length again, in that channel around off and seaming in late off the surface. Cameron Green looks to drive but gets beaten past the outside edge.
On off, Green keeps it out.
Cameron Green is the new batsman in.

OUT! TAKEN! A catastrophe for Australia as Ben McDermott departs as well! McDermott looks to shimmy down the track but Mohammad Wasim sees him coming and bangs it in short, on off. McDermott gets cramped for room and tries to work it leg side but he hops and gets a leading edge on the off side. Iftikhar Ahmed at short cover is quick to dive in front and take a good catch. Half the Australian side is now back in the hut!
Commentary.Howout: c Iftikhar Ahmed b Mohammad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, around off. McDermott blocks it out.
Full and wide outside off, Alex Carey paddles it to fine leg to pick up a couple.
Loopy ball, on middle. Alex Carey knocks it back to the other side of the stumps. Zahid Mahmood got his fingers on it and appeals for a run out but Ben McDermott was well in.
Short and on leg, Ben McDermott works it to long on. A little bit of hesitation regarding the single but they get it easily in the end.
Full, on middle. Alex Carey sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Floats it up, outside off. Kept out.
Tossed up, on off. Carey prods and pushes it back to the bowler.
Edged but safe again! Length ball, outside off. Alex Carey looks to drive. The ball goes off the outside edge but just past the outstretched hands of the first slip fielder for a single.
On a good length, outside off. Alex Carey taps it to point.
Good length, on middle. Ben McDermott hops and pushes it to mid on for a quick single.
Length ball, outside off. Ben McDermott slashes it hard but straight to point.
Edged but safe! Good-length ball, shaping away from middle. Alex Carey has a poke but the ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a run.
Back of a length, on off. Ben McDermott nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and loopy, outside off. Alex Carey keeps it out.
Alex Carey walks in to bat at number 6.

OUT! CAUGHT! Just when the partnership started blossoming for Australia, Zahid Mahmood has gotten the breakthrough. Credit to Imam-ul-Haq for pulling a stunner though. Tossed up nicely from Zahid Mahmood, on middle and this one does turn. Marcus Stoinis lunges forward and looks to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball goes to the left of cover where Imam-ul-Haq puts in a dive and grabs the catch. Australia lose their fourth wicket.
On off, punched to long off for one.
FOUR! Runs are flowing thick and fast now! Loopy ball, on middle. Ben McDermott gets down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg. The boundary also brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
Tossed up, outside off. Pushed to point.
Floats it up, on middle. Marcus Stoinis punches it to long on for a run.
FOUR! Slashed! Length ball, outside off. Ben McDermott stays deep and cuts it hard and through point for another boundary. Australia slowly crawling back here.
WIDE! A wayward delivery wide outside off, Ben McDermott leaves it alone. Wide given.
Now pushes this length ball to mid off for a single.
SIX! That's a beauty! Good-length ball, on off. Marcus Stoinis stands talll, picks it up beautifully and smacks it flat over long on for a maximum. Well-timed shot!
Back of a length, outside off. Ben McDermott dabs it down to third man and crosses ends.
On a length, on off. Ben McDermott uses his feet and slashes it to mid off.
Length ball, on off. Ben McDermott punches it to extra cover.
Mohammad Wasim is now into the attack.
Full and wide outside off, Marcus Stoinis reaches out and looks to sweep but gets hit on the shoe.
On off, Ben McDermott goes back and cuts it to deep cover for a run.
This is steered to deep backward point for a brace.
SIX! BOOM! Ben McDermott decides to break the shackles! Short and on middle and leg, Ben McDermott rocks back and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Full and on off, Ben McDermott presses forward and blocks it out.
Tossed up, on off. Ben McDermott punches it towards covers.
End of Powerplay 1! 4 fielders are now allowed outside the inner circle till the 40th over. Also, Zahid Mahmood is brought into the attack.
Slower one, around leg stump. McDermott drops it towards mid-wicket and picks up an easy single. At the end of the first Powerplay, Australia are 31/3!
Rauf bends his back and bowls a length ball at 148.5 kph, around off. Stoinis pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for one. Rauf falls over on the followthrough and seems a bit hurt. Hope he is fine.
Length again, a bit wider. McDermott cuts it late down to third man for a run.
Slower one, around off. This is steered away towards point.

Risky cricket from Ben McDermott but he gets away with it. Length again, on off. McDermott looks to lift it over mid off but gets it off the splice of the bat. The ball just clears Babar Azam at mid off but he does well to chase it down and save the boundary. Two taken.
Rauf hits the length hard and bowls it on off. McDermott keeps it down on the off side.
Right off the middle of the bat but shatters the stumps at the other end. On middle, punched dead straight and unluckily for Stoinis, he hits the stumps.
FOUR! Hammered! Banged in short, outside off with not much pace on it. Marcus Stoinis hangs back and drags the pull shot well in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Slower one, around middle. Stoinis watchfully keeps it out.
Fuller this time, on middle and punched to the right of mid off. Yet again Babar Azam makes a good stop and keeps it down to just a single.
On middle, this is driven on the up to the right of mid off. Babar Azam scrambles to his right and makes a half-stop, saving a boundary. Two taken.
Very full, almost at the base of the off pole. McDermott jams it out towards covers.
Around off, pushed towards mid off.
Around the top of off, Stoinis solidly blocks it off.
FOUR! Overpitched and punished! On off, driven through mid off for a glorious boundary.
Length this time, angled into middle and leg at 144.7 clicks. Stoinis dabs it down on the leg side.
Fullish delivery at 145.5 kph and there's width on offer. Marcus Stoinis goes after it but hits it straight to the man at point.
Just short of a length, on off. McDermott pulls it a bit aerially off the back foot and towards deep square leg for a run.
Full, close to the off pole and at 141 clicks. Stoinis pushes it towards mid off.
Full and straight, punched back towards the bowler.
WIDE! Shaheen Afridi bangs it in short, around leg stump. The ball is a bit too high and down the leg side. Wided.
Good running. Length this time, on middle. McDermott drops it onto the on side and sets off for a quick run.
Pitched up, on off. McDermott nudges it onto the off side.
Full and wide, driven past the man at short cover but Babar Azam from extra cover runs to his left and cuts it off. Single taken.
Length, around leg stump. Stoinis gets pushed onto the back foot as he squeezes it out and Afridi falls over in his followthrough. He is fine though.
Length again, over off stump and nipping in late. McDermott looks for the big heave across the line but gets comprehensively beaten.
FOUR! Top shot! Pitched up at 145.8 kph and on off. Ben McDermott straight drives right back past the bowler and collects a boundary.
Fullish delivery, around off. McDermott strokes it away towards covers.
Good length, on off. Kept out.
Full and slanting into middle and leg. Stoinis works it towards wide mid on for a single.
Marcus Stoinis walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Haris Rauf strikes again and Australia in dire straits at the moment! This is brilliant bowling, a length ball, right around the top of off stump but a bit wider. The ball just nips away ever so slightly after pitching. Marnus Labuschagne pushes at it but gets an outside edge. The ball goes straight into the clutches of Iftikhar Ahmed at first slip who makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Iftikhar Ahmed b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller in length, on off. Ben McDermott drives it to mid off. A maiden!
Follows up with a bouncer now, on middle. Ben McDermott tries to pull but fails to make any connection.
A yorker, on off. Ben McDermott jams it out on the leg side. Shaheen Afridi is bowling exceptionally well at the moment.
On a length, on middle and leg, slower one this time. Ben McDermott chips it wide of the bowler and the ball rolls to mid on.
Full and outside off. No problem for Ben McDermott as he lets it sail through.
Length ball, angling away from off. Ben McDermott pushes it to mid off.
Good-length ball, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne taps it to cover-point.
Length ball, at 145.6 kph, on off. Marnus Labuschagne pushes it to mid on.
Length ball, on leg. Ben McDermott looks to clip it on the leg side but misses. The ball goes off his pads to fine leg for a leg bye.
On a good length, on off. Ben McDermott stands up on his toes and punches it towards covers.
Length, on off. Ben McDermott punches itto mid off.
Good-length ball, on middle. Ben McDermott gets behind the line and knocks it back to the bowler.
Another full ball, at 140.6 kph, on middle. Marnus Labuschagne squeezes it out to mid-wicket. Another excellent over from Shaheen Afridi. Just a single off it.
Fuller, on the pads. Marnus Labuschagne keeps it out.

A huge appeal for a caught behind but nothing from the umpire. Full ball, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne tries to slice it away but gets beaten. Only Shaheen Afridi appeals for a catch as he gets no support from Mohammad Rizwan or any other fielder. He is adamant that there was an edge there and asks Babar Azam to opt for the review. UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved there. An unnecessary review from Pakistan.
On a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne leaves it alone.
Full, on middle. Ben McDermott works it to mid on for a single.
On a length, outside off. Ben McDermott lets it be.
Length ball, on middle. Marnus Labuschagne hops and defends it on the leg side.
FOUR! Australia get underway and Marnus Labuschagne is off the mark with a boundary. Fuller, on off. Marnus Labuschagne flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence.
On a length, on off. Marnus Labuschagne blocks it out.
Marnus Labuschagne is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Pakistan are right on the money! Shaheen Afridi in the first over and now it's Haris Rauf! Aaron Finch departs for a duck again. This is some start from Pakistan. Good-length ball, on middle and leg, coming into the right-hander. Aaron Finch is beaten by the pace and swing. He goes on the front foot and tries to nudge it on the leg side but misses. The ball hits his pads and Haris Rauf puts up an appeal. He knew it straightaway and Aleem Dar raises his finger in a split second without any hesitation. Aaron Finch starts walking off and Australia in massive early trouble.
Length ball, nipping away from middle. Aaron Finch covers the line and drives it to mid off.
Good-length ball, outside off, shaping in a tad. Aaron Finch watches the ball closely and shoulders arms.
Haris Rauf to speed in from the opposite end.
A wicket maiden to start from Shaheen Afridi! Fuller in length, on off. Ben McDermott drives it to mid off. Superb start for Pakistan!
This is brilliant bowling! Another yorker, on middle, nipping in. Ben McDermott does well to bring his bat down in time and dig it out.
A yorker now, on leg. Ben McDermott clears his front leg and jams it out.
Fuller, on middle. Ben McDermott defends it out.
Beauty! Length ball, nipping away, outside off. Ben McDermott looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Ben McDermott walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! A dream start for Pakistan and Shaheen Afridi! Travis Head is in the form of his life but has to depart. Aaron Finch for a duck in the second ODI and now Travis Head here for a golden duck. It's difficult to stop Shaheen Afridi when he gets going. An outswinging low full toss, on off, dipping on the way. Travis Head gets beaten by the swing completely and the ball goes past his blade and clips the base of the off stump.

We are ready for play! Once again Babar Azam has opted to chase under lights and the surface is even better than the previous two reckons Waqar Younis. The umpires are out in the middle and so are the Pakistani players. The Australian opening pair of skipper Aaron Finch and Travis Head make their way to the middle as well. Shaheen Afridi has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), Travis Head, Ben McDermott, Marnus Labuschagne, Marcus Stoinis, Cameron Green, Alex Carey (WK), Sean Abbott, Nathan Ellis, Adam Zampa and Jason Behrendorff (In for Mitchell Swepson).

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Imam-ul-Haq, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Asif Ali (In for Saud Shakeel), Iftikhar Ahmed, Khushdil Shah, Mohammad Wasim, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf and Zahid Mahmood.
TOSS - Up goes the flip of the coin and it lands in favour of Pakistan. They have elected to BOWL first.

Australia lost the second ODI but they would still be confident coming into this game as their batters have batted beautifully throughout. They would want their bowlers to step up this time and win the game for them. They will be keen to come out guns blazing and win the series in Pakistan's home soil. Toss and team news coming up shortly.

Chasing a mammoth total of 349 in the second ODI, Pakistan did not stutter even a bit during the chase and cracked their highest successful run chase in ODIs. They will be riding high on confidence after that win and need their batters to put up a spirited performance again and win the series.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the third and final ODI between Australia and Pakistan. If Australia won the first ODI comfortably then Pakistan put up a show in the second ODI and the series is now nicely poised at 1-1. Both teams would give their all in this game but only one team will emerge victorious. Which team will take the series home? We shall find out soon.
